subject: general
question: The "Cancel Coal" case, which was seen in news in December 2024, is associated with which of the following country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Africa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The "Cancel Coal" case is a landmark climate change lawsuit in **South Africa** that gained international attention in **December 2024** following a significant court ruling.
 
• In a historic judgment, the **High Court of South Africa (Gauteng Division, Pretoria)** ruled against the government's plans to procure **1,500 MW** of new coal-fired power capacity.
 
• The litigation was spearheaded by youth and environmental groups, including the **African Climate Alliance (ACA)**, **groundWork**, and the **Vukani Environmental Justice Alliance**, who challenged the **Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) 2019**.
 
• The court determined that the Minister of **Mineral Resources and Energy** had failed to conduct a proper **Climate Change Impact Assessment** before including new coal power in the national energy plan.
 
• The ruling is particularly significant because it explicitly recognized that the climate crisis poses a direct threat to the **constitutional rights** of **children** and future generations in **South Africa**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Energy Profile of South Africa**: **South Africa** remains one of the world's most coal-dependent nations, with the mineral accounting for nearly **80%** of its electricity generation, primarily managed by the state-owned utility **Eskom**.
 
• **Constitutional Protection**: The legal basis for the "Cancel Coal" case rests on **Section 24** of the **Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996**, which guarantees citizens the right to an environment that is not harmful to their health or well-being.
 
• **The Integrated Resource Plan (IRP)**: This is a **Cabinet-approved** roadmap for **South Africa’s** electricity generation. The **IRP 2019** version was contested because it mandated the addition of new coal power despite the availability of cleaner, cheaper renewable alternatives.
 
• **Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP)**: **South Africa** is a pioneer in the **JETP** model, an international financial framework designed to help developing economies phase out coal. The "Cancel Coal" victory aligns with the national goal of achieving **Net Zero** emissions by **2050**.
 
• **Global Precedent**: The case is viewed as a major victory for **climate litigation** globally, demonstrating how courts can hold governments accountable for the long-term environmental consequences of energy policy and their impact on **human rights**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **December 2024** ruling essentially "cancelled" the specific allocation for coal in the **IRP 2019**, forcing the government to re-evaluate its energy mix with stricter environmental oversight.
 
• Legal experts highlight that this case establishes the **"best interests of the child"** principle as a primary consideration in national administrative decisions regarding **fossil fuel** infrastructure.
 
• The **Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE)** had previously argued that new coal was necessary for **energy security**, but the court found that this did not exempt the state from its **environmental obligations**.
